notes:
Read-along got its timing back.

A real pause when the story hands over to a character. The old one was too short to hear as a handover, and pause — not pitch — is what actually tells you somebody else is talking. This is the single biggest thing that makes two voices sound like two people.

Questions land properly now. A balloon that asks something gets a beat before the answer, so an exchange sounds like an exchange instead of one voice reading both halves.

Page turns and chapter breaks always outlast any pause inside a page — at every reading speed, including the slowest.

Voices in Settings tells you the truth. If casting can't work it now says why and what to do, instead of claiming to be on and quietly doing nothing.

Also fixed: a stutter where the next line was prepared in the wrong voice and had to be re-made mid-page.
